title: Energetic · adj.
subtitle: 「有活力／活潑／活躍／精力充沛」，究竟是哪一種 energetic？
description: 「有活力／活潑／活躍／精力充沛」，究竟是哪一種 energetic？

words.meaning: 活潑的；生氣勃勃的；充滿活力的
words.note: 使用者提供。lively 強調一個人、活動、氣氛或表現充滿生氣、反應快、讓場面有活力。它和 energetic 高度接近，但更偏 spirited / animated，而不一定表示體力充沛。
words.example: She gave a lively presentation that kept the audience engaged.

exercises.original: The class became energetic once the discussion began.
exercises.zh: 討論開始後，課堂氣氛變得十分活潑。
exercises.upgrade: lively · 活潑的；生氣勃勃的；充滿活力的

options.explanation: class + discussion refers to animated atmosphere rather than physical stamina.
常與 lifestyle, role, children, participation 搭配，突出活動量。 本題的決定性線索是 an animated classroom atmosphere；這裡需要的是「生動活潑／有生氣」。因此 active 雖與 energetic 有重疊，但活動類型、情緒色彩、表達方式或節奏不如 lively 精確。
常與 conversation, discussion, account 搭配，表示表情／語氣／動作生動。 本題的決定性線索是 an animated classroom atmosphere；這裡需要的是「生動活潑／有生氣」。因此 animated 雖與 energetic 有重疊，但活動類型、情緒色彩、表達方式或節奏不如 lively 精確。
常與 leader, sector, team, style 搭配，表示有推動力與變化。 本題的決定性線索是 an animated classroom atmosphere；這裡需要的是「生動活潑／有生氣」。因此 dynamic 雖與 energetic 有重疊，但活動類型、情緒色彩、表達方式或節奏不如 lively 精確。
常形容 children, animals, young people，帶興奮、活蹦亂跳意味。 本題的決定性線索是 an animated classroom atmosphere；這裡需要的是「生動活潑／有生氣」。因此 high-spirited 雖與 energetic 有重疊，但活動類型、情緒色彩、表達方式或節奏不如 lively 精確。
常與 mood, atmosphere, investors, personality 搭配，表示樂觀振奮。 本題的決定性線索是 an animated classroom atmosphere；這裡需要的是「生動活潑／有生氣」。因此 buoyant 雖與 energetic 有重疊，但活動類型、情緒色彩、表達方式或節奏不如 lively 精確。

words.meaning: 活躍的；活動量大的；積極參與的
words.note: 使用者提供。active 強調經常活動、參與或保持忙碌，可用於人、生活方式、組織、社群。它比 energetic 更偏 activity level，而不一定帶 enthusiasm。
words.example: She remains active in several community groups.

exercises.original: He is very energetic and exercises almost every day.

exercises.upgrade: active · 活躍的；活動量大的；積極參與的

falseSynonyms.zh: lively 強調生動、有生氣、氣氛活潑；energetic 更直接指精力或活動量高。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The discussion was lively. The children were energetic.

falseSynonyms.zh: active 只要求經常活動或參與；一個人可以 active 但不一定顯得精力旺盛。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is active in local politics. He is energetic from early morning.

falseSynonyms.zh: vigorous 更強調力量、強度和有力行動；不是所有 energetic personalities 都可叫 vigorous。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He follows a vigorous exercise routine. She has an energetic personality.

falseSynonyms.zh: animated 主要是說話、表情和動作因興奮而生動；體能上的 energetic 不一定 animated。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They had an animated discussion. He remained energetic throughout the hike.

falseSynonyms.zh: dynamic 強調能推動變化、形成動力；energetic 可以只是精力旺盛。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is a dynamic leader. The puppy is energetic.

falseSynonyms.zh: hyperactive 往往表示活動量異常高、難以安靜，並可有臨床／負面含義；不能當作一般 energetic 的普通同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The child seemed unusually hyperactive. The children were energetic after lunch.

falseSynonyms.zh: athletic 表示運動能力／體格好；一個人可以 athletic 但當下不 energetic，反之亦然。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is an athletic runner. She felt energetic this morning.

falseSynonyms.zh: energetic 是形容詞；energy 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is energetic. He has a lot of energy.
